_source.displayname: [149436] West Norwood Memorial Park Tomb of Elizabeth King (Early 20th Century Tomb)
_source.displaydescription: Built in 1922 the tomb has a marble figure and is dedicated to Elizabeth King.
Gardens and pleasure grounds laid out in the 1870s as the setting to a private residence, developed and extended in the 1890s and early 1900s.

_source.displayname: [98867] The Guards Memorial (Early 20th Century War Memorial)
_source.displaydescription: War memorial by Gilbert Ledward (sculptor) and Harold Chalton Bradshaw (architect). Unveiled in 1926 by the Duke of Connaught (Senior Colonel of the Guards) and Gen. George Higginson, a Crimean veteran.
